title: Oracle security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-235.101619: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – ORACLE SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Oracle has released its Critical Patch Update for October 2019 to address 219 vulnerabilities across multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system. Due to the threat posed by a successful attack, TTCSIRT strongly recommends that administrators apply the Critical Security Patch Update as soon as possible.
